summaryZh: Z Lab 研究通过算法、系统和应用层创新使人工智能更小、更快和更高效。团队设计高效模型架构、稀疏化与压缩方法，并开发面向硬件的加速支持。

evidence.quote: We focus on making AI smaller, faster, and more efficient through full-stack innovations: 🧠 Algorithm : Designing efficient model architectures and approximations (e.g., sparsity, compression). ⚙️ System : Building hardware-aware system support to accelerate emerging AI workloads. 🚀 Application : Working with real-world use cases in generative AI, robotics, and scientific discovery. We are part of the UCSD ML Systems Group and the UCSD Center for Visual Computing . News Jul 2026 DFlash is accepted to ICML 2026! DFlash uses block diffusion for speculative decoding, achieving up to 6× lossless acceleration. Jan 2026 ParoQuant is accepted to ICLR 2026! ParoQuant enables efficient reasoning LLM inference through pairwise rotation quantization. Jan 2026 DFlash is released! DFlash uses block diffusion for speculative decoding, enabling efficient and high-quality parallel drafting. Jun 2025 SparseVILA is accepted to ICCV 2025! SparseVILA decouples visual token sparsity for efficient vision-language model inference. Jun 2025 SparseLoRA is accepted to ICML 2025! SparseLoRA applies contextual sparsity to skip unnecessary computations during fine-tuning, achieving up to 2.2× compute reduction. Highlights DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference ParoQuant: Pairwise Rotation Quantization for Efficient Reasoning LLM Inference ParoQuant: Pairwise Rotation Quantization for Efficient Reasoning LLM Inference FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference For Autonomous Driving VLASH: Real-Time VLAs via Future-State-Aware Asynchronous Inference
